pokedexEntries.go: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

pokedexEntries.si: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

pokedexEntries.cr: Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

pokedexEntries.rs: FORRETRESS conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the POKéMON is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
